_**Agent (auto-smart)**_

Both specs were already strong (2026-10-04 drafts with T1–T5, X1–X3, the 5×5 matrix, and per-endpoint HTTP examples). I added the gaps below so transitions and the HTTP surface are explicit for implementation and tests.

### [`spec/state-machine.md`](spec/state-machine.md)

- **§5.5** — Valid transition operations: per-edge table (current → PATCH `status`, success HTTP, persisted result) plus standard PATCH shape.
- **§5.6** — **All 20 illegal pairs** numbered with category (self, skipped hop, backward, terminal, reopen X1–X3) and **409** message pattern.
- **§5.7** — Domain API (`assertTransitionAllowed` / `isTransitionAllowed`); self-transitions explicitly disallowed.
- **§6.1.1** — When `status` is omitted, `{}`, equals current, or invalid enum (vs legal transition).
- **AC-SM-06–08** — Tests for full illegal register, self-transition, and field-only PATCH.

Existing **§5.4** master matrix and T1–T5 / X1–X3 tables were left as-is.

### [`spec/api-contract.md`](spec/api-contract.md)

- **§2.11** — Single catalog: all **7** endpoints with method, URI, request model, query params, success HTTP, response `data` type, and `meta` rules.
- **§3.5** — `AskResponseData` (`answer`, `citedTicketIds`).
- **§4.4.1** — T1–T5 PATCH table (request body + response `status`) plus illegal examples cross-linked to the state machine.
- **AC-API-08/09** — Contract coverage for the catalog and transition PATCH behaviour.

**Unchanged / still open:** **DEC-02** (only T1–T5), **DEC-06** (PATCH `status`), **DEC-11** (ask wording in `rag-api-contract.md`). No new routes beyond the seven listed endpoints.

If you want next, I can align `spec/test-strategy.md` with AC-SM-06–08 and AC-API-08/09.

Created **[`spec/rag-ingestion.md`](spec/rag-ingestion.md)** and linked it from requirements, architecture, data-model, documentation, assessment-brief, and test-strategy.

### Contents (high level)

**§4 — What gets ingested (PDF-aligned)**  
- **In text:** description, comments, resolution notes (`DEC-05`); header includes title + metadata line (**Convention**).  
- **Not in text:** status **transition history** (no audit table), assignee/priority **change log** — only current values in **chunk metadata** at ingest time.

**§6 — Paragraph / comment-boundary chunking**  
- Sections (`Description`, `Comments`, `Resolution`); **one block per comment**; blank-line splits in description/resolution; overflow handled separately.

**§7 — Fixed-size chunking**  
- Sentence-biased splits with overlap; comparison of **fixed-size-only** vs using it only as overflow.

**§8 — Comparison table**  
- Paragraph vs fixed vs **hybrid** across description, comments, resolution, and “history/transitions” (metadata-only for lifecycle).

**§9 — Recommendation**  
- **Hybrid:** paragraph/comment-first, then fixed-size **only** for blocks &gt; `max-chars`; optional **min-chars** merge **within the same section**, never across comments.  
- **Proposed** defaults: `max-chars=800`, `min-chars=120`, `overlap-chars=80`, strategy `HYBRID_PARAGRAPH_THEN_FIXED` — marked **Proposed** until you confirm.

**§10–§12** — Re-ingest triggers (**DEC-01** interim: update **or** close, including status-only refresh), delete-and-replace storage, **DEC-09** still open for model/dimension.

**§14** — **AC-RAG-ING-01…08** for tests.
